verdict: Yes, while the sport is still young in India. Goodland Pickleball pitched premium paddles and courts on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Pickleball is growing fast in Indian cities, and paddles, balls, court building and coaching are all open markets.
angle: Pickleball is easy to learn and appeals to all ages, and housing societies, clubs and schools are adding courts. Equipment, court construction and coaching can each be a business. The early market is small, so combine products with events and leagues to grow the player base.
